test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five salesmen A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a meeting around a circular table. A is to the immediate left to E. C is to the immediate left of B. D is sitting between B and A. Who is sitting at the second place to the right of E?
solution:
Five salesmen A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a meeting around a circular table.

1) A is to the immediate left to E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0093da93d02ce8c4e929967cb1440ebdb6e4904162bc3981f67ab74377cec4c1.png] 

2) C is to the immediate left of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19e99f3c08ce65d6668438f9aa0a546e269ed394d3b3e9e3c3191f642074c0f3.png] or [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1a77bed9c855dbf8a51e09741d72cd0560d99da025b18730ba5284f163ea4ed.png] 

3)D is sitting between B and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5836f89b3c41386c2313ec6dd57cbcee707aea8905546b3f81014971758d486a.png] 

∴ Here, 'B' is sitting at the second place to the right of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B"**.
